Enormous
solution: The correct answer is **'Negligible'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word **'Enormous' **means extremely large in size, quantity, or extent. ('विशाल' or 'बड़ा'). • Example: The project required an enormous amount of work • **'Negligible' **means something which is so small or unimportant as to be not worth considering; insignificant. ('नगण्य' or 'तुच्छ'). • Example: The difference between the two products is negligible.
